page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs and 480.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of approximately 8.57 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a high memory density makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints without the overhead of local storage maintenance. However, the lack of bundled local storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff for applications dependent on high-speed local disk I/O or hardware-accelerated parallel processing.

Given its high memory capacity and dedicated CPU resources, the ecs.se1.14xlarge is designed for memory-intensive workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing or analytics tasks that do not require local NVMe storage.
